entries.47d37c49db459f60: A housing-related equipment manufacturer in Sanjo, Niigata Prefecture, that started with oil stoves and makes and sells housing equipment such as EcoCute, heating equipment, and air conditioning and home appliances.
entries.7a772e449bcb567d: In addition to real estate leasing, this business covers housing house cleaning and renovation, and non-life insurance agency services, and comprises activities not included in the product categories above. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,853 million.
entries.8da40168ba89b9e7: Heating equipment such as kerosene stoves, kerosene fan heaters, FF-type heaters and electric heaters. They are manufactured at the Sanjo Plant, the Kashiwazaki Plant and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥23,300 million.
entries.95c3f43841a7df00: This is a single-segment business whose main activities are manufacturing, sales and installation of heating equipment, air-conditioning and home appliances, and housing equipment. Products are manufactured by the company and its manufacturing subsidiaries Arai Corona, Imamachi Corona and Tochio Corona, and sold through the company and its sales subsidiaries, including Yamato Kogyo and Kintatsu Shoji. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥85,338 million.
entries.bac037db2ee9b5ec: Water heating and heating equipment such as EcoCute (natural refrigerant CO2 heat pump water heaters), oil-fired water heaters and electric water heaters. They are manufactured at the Nagaoka Plant, the Kashiwazaki Plant and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥42,367 million, the largest among product categories.
entries.d34a1cddc709c663: Air-conditioning and home appliances such as room air conditioners, dehumidifiers and humidifiers. They are manufactured at the Sanjo Plant and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥13,816 million.
